learning_outcomes.text: The student can draw up a statement of requirements based on the analysis of business processes.
The student can draw up a functional analysis based on the statement of requirements.
Based on the functional analysis, the student can create a technical analysis of the software to be developed.
Using the preceding analyses, the student can draw up a set of tests for the software to be developed.

syllabus_topics: principles of statement of requirements and analysis of business processes
Application of topics treated during theory to a self-chosen project during the lab
assessment_rules: The total grade is based on a 1-20 point scale, with 50% for theory and 50% for lab work. For resits, the theory exam can be retaken, and lab assignments can be updated or improved. There are no partial transfers for this course unit.
bibliography: Course material on the learning platform (Powerpoint and other reference material)
